title: Freestyle: A Footbag Story
overview: Featuring members of the Big Add Posse, 'Freestyle: A Footbag Story' is an award winning documentary following the origins of Freestyle Footbag, a little known sport which grew out of Hacky Sack circles in the late 80s and 90s.
